steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Can't believe a Mania bomb like this has been planted in downtown Eastside for so long... I need to contact the Bureau immediately.

You push against the crowd to return to the locker to retrieve your comms device, rescuing several participants attacked by Mania-corrupted monsters on the way. To avoid alerting the Witch, you don't initiate a call, but quickly and quietly write a message to your colleagues at the Bureau.

<color=#fb9259>Wynn</color>: Chief, aren't you supposed to be off today? Is the murder mystery game over? How was it?

<color=#fb9259>Chief</color>: Wynn, there's a Mania outbreak at the murder mystery game place. We have an unidentified Sinner named Irrheia, who claims to be a staff member. Estimated threat level is S-Class. I need you to find her real identity for me.

<color=#fb9259>Chief</color>: I've had a confrontation with this Sinner during the game. Mania has now spread to the streets of Eastside. Inform Nightingale, and contact the FAC immediately to secure the surrounding blocks, evacuate civilians, deploy anti-Mania devices, and prevent further contamination.

<color=#fb9259>Wynn</color>: Okay, on it now. Please stay safe, Chief!

<color=#fb9259>Chief</color>: Eugene, deploy a squad immediately and rendezvous with me for a raid to capture this Sinner! Take precautions. The suspect likely possesses an <color=#fb9259>Aurum Secretum weapon</color> that can alter spatio-temporal rules within her illusions. Stay alert at all times.

<color=#fb9259>Eugene</color>: Yes, Chief! Be there with the squad shortly.

The chaotic streets of Eastside seem to be gradually returning to order, and the Mania monsters that fled from the venue have mostly been contained. Your anxiety eases a little. You decide to contact Nightingale again to confirm the situation.
Buzz... Buzz... Signal lost.

<color=#fb9259>Eugene</color>: Chief, squad is ready. I'm heading to your position now.
<color=#fb9259>Eugene</color>: Chief... Chief?

Your hands are seized by Mania monsters emerging out of nowhere. Your device nearly falls to the ground but is caught just in time by two slender fingers. It's the Witch. Her finger swipes across the screen as she examines your messages with Wynn and Eugene, and she even begins commenting on them.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: So, a big shot like you is interested in these things? You could have just asked me directly.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why did you pull me into this illusion? What's your goal? My squad will be here any minute. If you stop now, we can still negotiate. Put away your weapon. Abusing its power will only harm you in the end.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Hehe, don't be so tense. Why can't you believe this is just a chance encounter?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Would an ordinary person possess an Aurum Secretum weapon? This Aurum Secretum hourglass can manipulate the physical rules inside illusions. Its power is immense, capable of causing widespread destruction... I'd believe it if you told me you're an Outland spy.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Well, this hourglass... is just a gift from another chance encounter. It adds a realistic touch to my scripts, that's all. On the streets of Eastside, one can always find interesting trinkets, wouldn't you agree?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...You expect me to believe you caused all this chaos with an Aurum Secretum weapon just to improve customer satisfaction?

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: The KPIs are stressing me out. You must know how it is, right? Sometimes you have to get creative to handle the boss's capricious ideas.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: ... Is the truth too uneventful to satisfy your expectations? Would you be more convinced by some elaborate conspiracy than a simple true event?
With unhurried composure, she turns over the hourglass in her hand and offers you a new story.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: I once met an injured soldier from the Outlands on a street in Eastside. She... would be what you call a Sinner, I guess?
The Witch lowers her gaze. Traces of sorrow appear on her pale face as she gently brushes her fingers over the hourglass.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: This hourglass was her weapon, and also her last remaining belonging. I don't know anything about her past or her true identity.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: She came to DisCity seeking a glorious finale, and ultimately died in my arms, entrusting this hourglass to me... asking me to complete her unfinished mission.
Her cold, detached manner from earlier has completely transformed. Lost in memories, her voice softens noticeably, revealing a trace of nostalgia. But you're clearly not so easily convinced.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yet you're using this important object as a prop to play the role of an employee stressing about KPIs.

The Witch blinks, apparently surprised you caught the inconsistency in her story immediately. She seems to have hastily concocted an explanation to placate you, but this only makes you feel as if she's fooling you.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Well, you're rather hard to please. I suppose there's only one way left to put it, then...
Once again, she turns the hourglass over. Another new story begins.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: I could be your Outland spy or Mania conspirator. But to tell you the truth, I'm just a mad woman who delights in toying with people's emotions while obsessively pursuing my evil agenda. Just like those Sinners in the urban legends, right? That's what you want me to be. That's why you've been interrogating me like a criminal from the start.

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Well, I shouldn't disappoint you, in that case. I'd better play the villainess role properly.

She squints her eyes as she smiles, her latest story clearly even more far-fetched than the previous ones. You've dealt with plenty of dishonest Sinners before, but you certainly don't see someone who can spin a new tale every few seconds like her every day.
You feel the veins on your forehead throbbing with anger. All you want now is to rush over and drag this Sinner with her non-stop stream of lies back to the MBCC for a proper interrogation.

The Witch suddenly drifts further away from you, leaving behind only echoes of mocking laughter. You barely take two steps after her when the ground beneath your feet suddenly softens, mysteriously transformed into a pool of sand.
A familiar figure scrambles out of the sand, lunges forward with outstretched arms, and grabs hold of your legs.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>The Witch... The Witch's power flows through me now! Heehee...</color>

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: <color=#fb9259>Hey, I've just started a brand new script. Don't leave... Play with me...</color>

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Eleanor?!

Eleanor appears completely taken over by Mania, and communication proves impossible. Meanwhile, the mastermind behind it all, the Witch, is hovering above the rooftop, shrugging innocently in your direction.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You just don't quit!

steps.speaker: Witch of Rewind
steps.content: Because this is what you want, isn't it?
